subject: ai
question: What is a plateau in hill climbing?
title: Plateau: Flat Means Blind
hook: What if the mountain you are climbing just goes flat?
answer: Plateau = a flat area of the state-space landscape where neighbouring states have the same evaluation value
No uphill move is visible, so the algorithm cannot choose a direction: it wanders randomly or stops
One of three hill-climbing problems: local maximum, ridge, plateau
Fix 1: allow sideways moves, with a limit on how many
